// purpose: Emits the declaration files that scripts/checks/check-public-contract.mjs
compares against its tracked baseline. Deliberately standalone rather than
extending the root config: the baseline has to be reproducible from the
pinned toolchain alone, so nothing here may inherit a setting that a later
edit to the root config could change underneath it.
removeComments is on because the contract is the API surface, not the prose.
Without it every docstring edit would churn the baseline and train reviewers
to run --update without reading the diff.
incremental / declarationMap / composite are off so the emit is a pure
function of the sources: no .tsbuildinfo carried between runs, no sourcemap
rootDir is pinned to the repo root rather than inferred. tsc derives it from
the common ancestor of everything in the program, so adding an import from
outside src/lib would silently relocate the emitted files and the checker
would look in the wrong place.
